messages:
ajay: Heads-up — after yesterday's gateway change some requests are billed to the org instead of the intended project. Suspect missing project claim during token exchange.
sofia: Confirmed in traces: exchange returns project claim ~68% on new path, rest are projectless and trigger org fallback.
maria: Any minimal repro/log snippet?
ajay: redacted: [auth] exchange claims={} sub=svc-555 -> routing fallback org-99
sofia: Old proxy used to synthesize origin-project header when exchange returned nothing. New path assumes exchange always sets project.
kai: Do NOT let synthesized values influence auth decisions. If we infer, make it telemetry-only and privacy-reviewed.
maria: Proposal: auth-service adds an `effective_project` telemetry tag used only for billing/observability and emits a sampled `auth.fallback` event when exchange lacks project. No exposure in audit logs.
sofia: Implementation: set effective_project = claims.get('project') or infer_from_token_meta(); if missing, sampler.emit('auth.fallback', payload={'project_hint': effective_project}) at 5% sample. Canonicalize project into cohorts for metrics.
ajay: Metrics: add auth.fallback.count{reason="no_project"} and aggregated auth.fallback.by_cohort derived from sampled events to keep cardinality low.
maria: Console: small "likely project" badge with confidence and a "dry-run reassign" action for SEs. Show provenance and sample id.
kai: Privacy: legal review mandatory before increasing sampling. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% only after sign-off.
sofia: Add debug toggle `auth.debug_full_attribution` for support (per-customer, audited).
ajay: Ops: canary auth-service with sampler at 5%, monitor billing drift and fallback metric. I'll open GH issue and tag privacy/legal.
infra-bot: Canary deploy queued: auth-service@canary (5% traffic) -> routing-proxy@stable.
maria: I'll draft console PR and dashboard panel for "Attribution anomalies".
sofia: I'll add unit + e2e tests and integration check for header preservation.
ajay: Thanks — track action items on the GH issue and loop in infra-oncall if billing drift > 2%.
